leadText:
Volume 62 is the 62nd volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is both the eighth and final volume in the and the first volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's English translation, this volume is published as volume one of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire".
plainText:
Volume 62 is the 62nd volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is both the eighth and final volume in the and the first volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's English translation, this volume is published as volume one of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire".

==Blurb==
 While training with Sapphire and their friend Steven in Sea Mauville, Emerald is attacked by a mystery Pokémon! Meanwhile, Ruby journeys to the Sky Pillar to earn the trust of Zinnia, the Lorekeeper of the reclusive Draconid tribe.

Can three Hoenn Pokédex holders stop a crisis of epic magnitude?
